workarounds.symptom: Installed skill documents `treg host`, but the CLI installed alongside it has no such subcommand
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): release 0.20.0 with treg host; add version note to skill. Target files: package.json, pyproject.toml, .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Fixes the mismatch between the installed skill (which documents `treg host`) and the released CLI (which didn't have it). Also adds a version guard in the skill documentation. (Ref: https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/pull/564)

workarounds.symptom: After logging in with GitHub, I can't see the page content anymore.
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(web): vendor Vue so a blocked CDN can't blank the dashboard. Target files: src/treg/api.py, src/treg/web/vendor/vue-3.5.41.global.prod.js, src/treg/web/index.html. Signing in only changes *which page you get*. `GET /` (`api.py`) serves `landing.html` to a signed-out visitor and redirects a signed-in one to `/app` — and `landing.html` has no external `<script>` tags at all, while `index.html` pulled Vue from `unpkg.com`. So "works in a brand new browser, blank once I log in" is really **"the landing works, the dashboar... (Ref: https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/pull/142)

workarounds.symptom: Render applies Brotli to `/mcp/` responses despite `Cache-Control: no-transform`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: gzip /mcp/ responses at the origin — the edge ignores no-transform. Target files: src/treg/mcp.py, tests/test_mcp.py, docs/context/architecture/mcp-oauth.md. (the remaining half of #93). (Ref: https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/pull/103)

workarounds.symptom: Hosted MCP responses have invalid nullable schemas and Brotli decoding failures
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: MCP responses validate against their advertised schemas, and forbid edge re-compression. Target files: src/treg/mcp.py, tests/test_mcp.py, docs/context/architecture/mcp-oauth.md. , the same schema failure independently reported on X the same day, plus a third schema mismatch found while re-running the reporter's exact flow. (Ref: https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg/pull/98)
